votes.motion: To approve July 10, 2025, Planning Commission Meeting minutes

To recommend application #REZ2025-001428 Amy Cosby is requesting a rezone from A-1 to R- 1-8 for approval to the Magna Council with the zoning condition to exclude PUD’s or any Multi-family/twin homes, single-family only

To recommend application #CUP2025-001379 Development Agreement – Cingular Wireless is proposing to co-locate on an existing monopole at 8585 W Magna Main Street, extending the height of the pole by twenty feet. The development agreement is to accommodate the additional height despite no approval process existing in the current code for approval to the Magna Council with correction to the parties

To recommend file #OAM2025-001454 Consideration of an ordinance adding Chapter 19.38 to Title 19 of the Magna Municipal Code establishing Public Facilities and Institutions Zones to be used on properties to be designated at a later date through the rezone process for approval to the Magna Council with the amendments of add religious facilities to the PI definition and remove hospital from the table of uses

To recommend file #OAM2025-001462 Proposed amendment to Chapter 19.42 Specific Use Standards, to waive standards related to lot size, building orientation, street frontage, and building height to allow the adaptive re-use of existing buildings when the proposed land use is permitted in the underlying zone for approval to the Magna Council with Staff Recommendation
